title: Hasselblad X2D II 100C Medium Format
purpose: State-of-the-art 100MP medium-format handheld precision with 16-bit color, 15.3 stops dynamic range, and Hasselblad Natural Colour Solution (HNCS).

sensor_and_optics.lens: Hasselblad XCD 2,5/90V Reference Portrait Lens stopped down to f/5.6 sweet spot
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 16-bit raw color depth with 15.3 stops dynamic range and HNCS
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Integrated leaf shutter with up to 1/4000s flash sync and 5-axis 10-stop in-body image stabilization (IBIS)

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Natural daylight balanced strobe, 1/2000s leaf shutter flash sync, base ISO 64, 16-bit raw tonal range
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Large parabolic key modifier with subtle organic negative fill; gradual specular highlight roll-off and authentic HNCS color separation

surface_rendering: Natural epidermal skin texture with resolved pores, fine vellus hair, and accurate subsurface dermal scattering without waxy specularities
True material micro-relief: fabric weave, micro-abrasions, uncompressed specular highlight falloff
High optical acutance and MTF contrast without digital edge halos or unsharp masking artifacts
depth_and_optics: Medium-format optical dimensionality with smooth focus plane transition
Zero perspective distortion, clean rectilinear projection
Soft natural background dissolution characteristic of large-sensor optics

execution_directive: Enforce Hasselblad X2D II 100C medium-format raw capture fidelity at 100MP with HNCS 16-bit color. Eliminate post-processed digital sharpening, synthetic smoothing, and non-physical lighting.
